changes.title: Clumps stamp
items: The oaks, beeches, ashes, limes and the other broadleaf trees now have crowns built from the same leaf stamps as the rest of the forest: each clump lit from one side and dark beneath, swaying on its own in the wind
The sprigs and low boughs on every tree's trunk are drawn the same way

changes.title: Music never stops
items: The music no longer seems to stop when you fly away from home: far from the speakers it's quieter and muffled, but you can still hear it

changes.title: Tufts stamp
items: With ?style=bold or ?style=ref the little tufts on the ground get the pixel-art look too: fewer, bolder blades, moss and pebbles as lit domes, heather in flower, ferns with clear fronds
